headline: Names a post office building in Chillicothe, Illinois, after Senior Chief Ryan Owens.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1114 North 2nd Street in Chillicothe, Illinois, as the "Sr. Chief Ryan Owens Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 23, 2018, and the designation took effect on that date.
